submarket: HIDDEN MARKET — "How do I function normally again after a C-section while caring for a newborn?"

finding.headline: "The Shuffling Grandma (mobility shame in community)"
finding.problem: "Aunties came to visit and I couldn't even stand to welcome them properly. I felt like they were judging me for not 'getting up like a real woman.'"
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "How do I function normally again after a C-section while caring for a newborn?"
finding.person: A 26-yr-old Igbo mom at 1 week post-CS, visitors arrive to "greet the new mother"; she can barely stand to receive them and fears they'll think she's weak/lazy.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Marketing angle / entry point (shame → reassurance) for A1.". Verdict: PASSES (4/5).
